statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder disputes a $125.00 installment payment from 'FITPRO EQUIPMENT CO.' The cardholder states the per-installment amount was supposed to be $99.00 based on what was shown during checkout. The $125.00 charged is higher than expected.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: The cardholder contacted FitPro [10 days after the disputed installment]. The merchant referenced the signed agreement and said the $99 was a promotional estimate and the actual installment is $125.00 per the terms. The cardholder disagrees.
statement.requestedResolution: Reversal of the $26.00 difference between expected and actual installment amount.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Medium — merchant may have valid defense documentation.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4850 (Installment Billing Dispute).
